name: type-to-confirm
title: Type to Confirm
description: GitHub-style confirm dialog (native <dialog>) that unlocks only after the exact phrase is typed, highlighting matched characters and flagging a typo the moment it happens; errors keep the dialog open.

meta.summary: Confirmation dialog that unlocks a destructive action only after the exact name is typed, flagging a typo as it happens.
meta.server: Authorize the destructive action server-side and confirm the target id there; the typed phrase is a UX guard only.
catches: Confirming before the exact phrase is typed
A typo, flagged at the first mismatching character
Failed confirms, which keep the dialog open with the error
limits: Case-sensitive exact match after trimming leading and trailing spaces
Typing a name proves attention, not authorization
Make the phrase the real target (repo, env, account) so it names what's at stake
a11y: Native <dialog> labelled and described by its title and description
Input has a <label>, autoFocus, aria-invalid and a polite hint
Confirm uses aria-disabled (stays discoverable) and aria-busy while pending
